description:
In the spring of 20 years old, Han Song-i, an ordinary college student who wants to meet a man of fate and fall in love. The moment she step into the shower room refreshed after exercising at the newly opened gym, a man comes out of the sauna room with his naked body… 'Huh? That's Hwang Jewang (the Emperor King)?!'

Hwang Jewang, the youngest professor at Hankuk University, is living a perfect life as his name suggests.  
One day, he falls into a huge mess for the first time in his life because of Han Song-yi, who he meets naked in the shower room... The self-illuminating professor and her quirky charms The sweet and salty campus scandal!
